sources.title: Yi-1.5-9B-Chat: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Yi-1.5-9B-Chat is a 9-billion-parameter instruction-tuned conversational model built by 01-ai that delivers competitive performance with models three to four times its size. The model uses the Transformers library and operates with a 4K context window (extendable variants exist at 16K and 32K).
